facts.text: Audrey suggests starting with small exposure for Scout and keeping them leashed.

evidence.quote: Sounds like a great start for Scout! Start small, and gradually give them more exposure. They'll have a great time, just make sure to keep them leashed.

facts.text: Andrew mentions keeping Scout on a leash while they get used to being outside and mentions having essentials like a bed, toys, and puppy pads.

evidence.quote: For now, we're keeping the new addition on a leash while they get used to being outside. That pic you of your dog at the park is so cute. So we got some essentials for their comfort and entertainment, like a bed, toys, and some puppy pads just in case.

facts.text: Audrey advises slowly introducing Scout to Toby and Buddy and expresses happiness for Scout having Andrew and his girlfriend.

evidence.quote: Slowly introduce Scout to Toby and Buddy, it takes time for the pups to get used to each other too! Scout is so lucky to have you and your girlfriend!

facts.text: Andrew expresses gratitude for having Scout and mentions the joy of having many furry friends.

evidence.quote: Thanks! We feel so lucky to have Scout. It's been amazing having so many furry friends!
